content: I understand you're interested in red shoes. The Prototipo RS is available in a Red/Black/Orange comfort version and a Black/Red comfort version. Both offer "all day comfort & versatility" with features like additional comfort padding, an ONSTEAM anti-microbial lining, and a removable cork & EVA foam insole.
